summary: Outputs left-eye and right-eye images to a connected OpenVR/SteamVR device.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable output to the OpenVR driver.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Explicit output width and height when using custom resolution.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark OpenVR TOP as Windows-only.
Requires two input textures, one for the left eye and one for the right eye.
SteamVR should usually be running so the connected VR device is available and functioning.
Common TOP resolution/aspect controls can resample images before headset submission.
Input render resolution and eye ordering must match the headset pipeline.
key_concepts: Outputs left-eye and right-eye images to a connected OpenVR/SteamVR device.
Uses separate input textures in the expected eye order.
Works alongside OpenVR CHOP/SOP and Audio Render CHOP for tracking, controller, and audio workflows.
The page exposes sparse unique params, so Common TOP resolution and format controls are part of the output contract.
